basic_details.job_title: Civil Court, Siwan Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon/ Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 support staff posts in the Evening Court, Siwan: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly, engaged purely on a contractual basis. The application form must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Siwan, in physical mode only, on or before 09 December 2026. Only those who retired within the three years before the date of publication of the notice are eligible.

content_sections.heading: About Siwan Civil Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Siwan, the head of the Civil Court, Siwan, Bihar (the Siwan Judgeship). It seeks support staff for the Evening Court, Siwan, and has been circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar and uploaded to the Siwan Judgeship website. The notice is signed by the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Siwan, and dated 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Siwan, on or before 09 December 2026, in physical mode only. The form note says it should be submitted in physical mode in the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Siwan. The notice does not print a fuller postal address or PIN code, and it does not name a postal service or say what to write on the envelope. The application form is printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice under the heading "Application Form for Engagement of Supporting Staff in the Evening Court, Civil Court, Siwan, Bihar" and is addressed to "The Principal District and Sessions Judge, Siwan". The form asks for: Name of candidate (in block letters), father's/husband's name and mother's name. Date of birth (as per Matriculation) and age as on 20-11-2026. Sex, marital status and nationality. Aadhaar number (mandatory). Date of retirement and the post retired from. The post applied for, ticked in the box for Stenographer, Clerk or Peon/ Orderly. Medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon, details of any FIR or criminal case and of any departmental proceeding (with its outcome). Permanent and correspondence addresses with mobile number, the list of documents attached, and a signed undertaking with place and date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the three years prior to the date of publication of the notice may apply. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work as well as working knowledge of computer. The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice gives no age limit; the application form only asks for the applicant's age as on 20-11-2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post. Remuneration/salary of the court staff (Retired Stenographer and Retired Clerk/Peon) and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No amount is printed in the notice. The engagement shall be purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court. The engagement shall not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service. The staff shall work for a minimum of 5 hours on each working day.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Recent passport size photograph (self attested), pasted on the form. Two self-addressed envelopes affixed with registered postal stamp (must be attached). Medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon (item 13 of the form). Status of any FIR or criminal case registered or pending with the police or any court, if there is one. Outcome of any departmental proceeding, if one was conducted (to be mentioned in the form). The documents listed by the applicant under item 18, "List of documents attached".

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Siwan Civil Court Evening Court recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/ Orderly for the Evening Court, Siwan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Siwan Civil Court Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: The application form must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Siwan, on or before 09 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Siwan Civil Court Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the three years prior to the date of publication of the notice, who are physically and mentally fit and have satisfactory service records without any major disciplinary punishment, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: A Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing, and a Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work as well as working knowledge of computer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Siwan Civil Court Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration/salary of the Retired Stenographer, Retired Clerk and Peon is governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; the notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Siwan Civil Court Evening Court recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form given with the notice and submit it in physical mode only so that it reaches the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Siwan, by 09 December 2026, with two self-addressed envelopes affixed with registered postal stamp.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Siwan Evening Court job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. How many hours will the Evening Court staff work?
faq.answer: The staff shall work for a minimum of 5 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q9. Is a medical certificate needed for the Siwan Civil Court Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Yes, the application form asks for a medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon.
